seutatawo-eneun han-guk haksaenggwa yuhaksaengi gachi sarayo

In room numbers, the first digit is usually the floor: Room 305 is usually on the 3rd floor. Your timetable shows the building name and room number together.
첫 수업 전에 미리 강의실을 찾아가 보면 지각하지 않습니다.
If you find the classroom before the first class, you won't be late.
dl: 이 길로 쭉 가면 왼쪽에 있어요.
Go straight along this road and it's on the left.
i gillo jjuk gamyeon oenjjoge isseoyo
Thanks. And what floor is Room 305 on?
The third floor. It's next to the elevator.
수업이 곧 시작해요. 같이 가 줄 수 있어요?
My class starts soon. Could you go with me?
su-eobi got sijakaeyo gachi ga jul su isseoyo?
Of course. I'm going to that building too.
sm: "-이/가 어디예요?", "몇 층이에요?"로 묻고, "쭉 가세요", "옆에 있어요"를 알아듣습니다.
Ask with "-이/가 어디예요?" and "몇 층이에요?", and understand "쭉 가세요" (go straight) and "옆에 있어요" (it's next to).

i: 전주대학교에는 스타센터와 학생회관에 학생 식당이 있습니다. 식당에서 주문하고 먹을 때 쓰는 말입니다.
Jeonju University has student cafeterias in the Star Center and the student union building. These are words for ordering and eating there.
w: I eat lunch at the student cafeteria.
The student cafeteria is cheaper than outside.
학생회관 학생 식당은 점심시간에 사람이 많아요.
haksaenghoegwan haksaeng siktangeun jeomsimsigane sarami manayo
The student union cafeteria is crowded at lunchtime.
메뉴판에 돼지고기가 들어 있는지 써 있어요?
menyupane dwaejigogiga deureo inneunji sseo isseoyo?
Does the menu say whether there's pork in it?
You buy meal tickets at the kiosk.
After buying a meal ticket, you line up.
Does the kiosk have an English menu?
If the kiosk is hard to use, ask a staff member.
천원의 아침밥은 빨리 끝나니까 일찍 가세요.
cheonwoni achimbabeun ppalli kkeunnanikka iljjik gaseyo
The 1,000-won breakfast runs out quickly, so go early.
Can I get this to go?
to be possible to take out
수업이 곧 있어서 포장해서 강의실에서 먹었어요.
su-eobi got isseoseo pojanghaeseo gangisireseo meogeosseoyo
I had class soon, so I got it to go and ate in the lecture room.
할랄 식당은 친구들에게 물어보면 알 수 있어요.
hallal siktangeun chin-gudeurege mureobomyeon al su isseoyo
You can find out about halal restaurants by asking friends.
tp: 전주대학교는 '천원의 아침밥'을 해 왔습니다. 2025년 2학기에는 화·수·목요일 아침에 교내 학생 식당에서 했습니다. 날짜와 시간은 학기마다 공지를 확인합니다.

Jeonju University has run a "1,000-won breakfast" for students. In the 2nd semester of 2025 it was on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday mornings at the campus student cafeterias. Check the notice each semester for dates and times.
고기를 안 먹거나 할랄 음식을 먹으면 "돼지고기 들어 있어요?", "고기 빼 주세요"라고 물어봅니다.
If you don't eat meat or eat only halal food, ask "돼지고기 들어 있어요?" (Is there pork in it?) or "고기 빼 주세요" (Please leave out the meat).
dl: 아흐마드 씨, 같이 학생 식당 갈래요?
Ahmad, want to go to the student cafeteria together?
aheumadeu ssi, gachi haksaeng siktang gallaeyo?
저는 돼지고기를 안 먹어요. 다른 메뉴도 있어요?
I don't eat pork. Is there another menu?
jeoneun dwaejigogireul an meogeoyo dareun menyudo isseoyo?
비빔밥도 있어요. 고기 빼 달라고 하면 돼요.
There's also bibimbap. You can ask them to leave out the meat.
bibimppapto isseoyo gogi ppae dallago hamyeon dwaeyo
sm: 학생 식당에서는 키오스크로 식권을 사고, 못 먹는 음식은 미리 물어봅니다.
At the student cafeteria, buy a meal ticket at the kiosk and ask in advance about food you can't eat.

i: 학교에서 아플 때는 보건실에 갈 수 있습니다. 많이 아프면 병원에 갑니다. 그때 쓰는 말입니다.
When you feel sick at school, you can go to the health room (보건실). If it's serious, you go to a hospital. These are the words you need.
w: I had a headache, so I went to the health room.
I got medicine at the health room.
보건실이 어디에 있는지 학교 누리집에서 확인했어요.
bogeonsiri eodie inneunji hakkyo nurijibeseo hwaginhaesseoyo
I checked on the school website where the health room is.
My throat has hurt since yesterday.
I was sick, so I couldn't go to class.
If you have a high fever, go to the hospital.
Because of my cold, I've lost my voice.
It's easy to catch a cold when the seasons change.
I need to go to the hospital.
I saw a doctor at a clinic near the school.
병원에 갈 때 외국인 등록증과 보험 카드를 가져가세요.
byeongwone gal ttae oegugin deungnokjeunggwa boheom kadeureul gajeogaseyo
Bring your residence card and insurance information when you go to the hospital.
I signed up for health insurance.
International students also need health insurance.
건강 보험이 있으면 병원비가 덜 나와요.
geon-gang boheomi isseumyeon byeongwonbiga deol nawayo
With health insurance, hospital bills are lower.
Please give me a medical certificate.
I was absent, so I gave the professor a doctor's note.
진단서는 돈을 내야 하는 병원도 있어요.
jindanseoneun doneul naeya haneun byeongwondo isseoyo
Some clinics charge for a medical certificate.
tp: 아픈 곳은 "-이/가 아파요"로 말합니다. 머리가 아파요, 배가 아파요.
Say where it hurts with "-이/가 아파요": 머리가 아파요 (I have a headache), 배가 아파요 (My stomach hurts).
유학생도 한국의 건강 보험에 가입해야 합니다. 자세한 것은 국민건강보험공단 안내나 국제교류원에 확인합니다. 응급일 때는 119에 전화합니다.
International students in Korea must also join the national health insurance. Check details with the National Health Insurance Service or the International Office. In an emergency, call 119.
pr: 열이 나다 to have a fever
dl: Excuse me, I have a headache and a fever.
Since when have you been sick?
어제 저녁부터요. 감기에 걸린 것 같아요.
Since yesterday evening. I think I caught a cold.
eoje jeonyeokputeoyo gamgie geollin geot gatayo
약을 줄게요. 내일도 열이 나면 병원에 가 보세요.
I'll give you some medicine. If you still have a fever tomorrow, go to a hospital.
yageul julgeyo nae-ildo yeori namyeon byeongwone ga boseyo
sm: 가볍게 아프면 보건실, 많이 아프면 병원에 갑니다. 결석하면 진단서를 냅니다.
For a mild illness go to the health room; for something serious go to a hospital. If you miss class, submit a doctor's note.
qz: 학교 안에서 아플 때 가는 곳은? 보건실 / 행정실

i: 한국어 수업에서 교수님이 자주 하는 말입니다. 이 앱에도 나오는 말이니 먼저 익혀 둡니다.
These are things the professor often says in Korean class. You will also see them in this app, so learn them first.
w: I borrowed a Korean book from the library.
I write new words in my notebook.
영어 수업 과제가 많아서 한국어 숙제를 못 했어요.
yeongeo su-eop gwajega manaseo han-gugeo sukjereul mot haesseoyo
I had a lot of work for my English-taught classes, so I couldn't do my Korean homework.
I wrote my name on the board.
뒤에 앉으면 칠판 글씨가 잘 안 보여요.
dwie anjeumyeon chilpan geulssiga jal an boyeoyo
If I sit at the back, I can't see the writing on the board well.
If you have a question, ask.
May I ask a question after class?
f: Look at the picture on the screen.
Listen to the conversation and answer the questions.
먼저 혼자 읽고 짝과 같이 읽으세요.
meonjeo honja ikko jjakkwa gachi ilgeuseyo
First read it alone, then read it with your partner.
Write the right word in the blank.
발음을 잘 듣고 천천히 따라 하세요.
bareumeul jal deutko cheoncheonhi ttara haseyo
Listen to the pronunciation carefully and repeat slowly.
Professor, I have a question about the homework.
Oh, now I know how to do it.
tp: "-(으)세요"는 공손하게 시키는 말입니다. 보세요, 읽으세요, 쓰세요.
"-(으)세요" is a polite way to tell someone to do something: 보세요 (look), 읽으세요 (read), 쓰세요 (write).
모르면 "모르겠어요", "다시 말해 주세요"라고 합니다.
If you don't understand, say "모르겠어요" (I don't know) or "다시 말해 주세요" (please say it again).
dl: 비어 있는 칸이에요. 여기에 단어를 쓰세요.
It's an empty box. Write a word here.
bieo inneun kanieyo yeogie daneoreul sseuseyo
sm: 수업의 지시는 "-(으)세요"로 끝납니다.
Classroom instructions end in "-(으)세요".

i: 영어 트랙 학생도 한국어 수업을 듣습니다. 한국어 수업에서 쓰는 낱말입니다.
English-track students also take Korean classes. These are words used in Korean class.
w: 전공 수업은 영어로 듣고 한국어도 배워요.
jeon-gong su-eobeun yeongeoro deutko han-gugeodo baewoyo
I take my major classes in English and also learn Korean.
I asked the professor a question.
한국어 교수님이 천천히 말해 주셔서 좋아요.
han-gugeo gyosunimi cheoncheonhi malhae jusyeoseo joayo
It's nice that the Korean professor speaks slowly for us.
There are fifteen students in our class.
우리 반에는 네팔, 그리스, 미국 학생이 있어요.
uri baneneun nepal, geuriseu, miguk haksaengi isseoyo
In our class there are students from Nepal, Greece and the US.
Please correct me if my pronunciation is wrong.
I memorize the words used often at school first.
문법을 배우고 나서 문장을 만들어 봐요.
munbeobeul bae-ugo naseo munjangeul mandeureo bwayo
After learning the grammar, we try making sentences.
What floor is the Korean classroom on?
Korean class is held in a classroom in 자유관.
There is a lot of homework.
Upload your homework to the Cyber Campus.
tp: "한국어"와 "한국말"은 같은 뜻입니다.
"한국어" and "한국말" mean the same: the Korean language.
영어 트랙 학생도 한국어를 배우면 학교 생활과 아르바이트, 친구 사귀기가 훨씬 쉬워집니다.
Even in the English track, learning Korean makes campus life, part-time jobs and making friends much easier.
"교수님"은 가르치는 사람뿐 아니라 의사나 처음 만난 어른을 높여 부를 때도 씁니다.
"교수님" is used not only for teachers but also to politely address doctors and older people you meet for the first time.
dl: 그리스에서 석 달 배웠어요. 지금은 학교에서 배워요.
I learned it in Greece for three months. Now I learn it at school.
geuriseu-eseo seok dal baewosseoyo jigeumeun hakkyo-eseo baewoyo
It's fun. But pronunciation is hard.
sm: 배우는 사람은 학생, 가르치는 사람은 교수님입니다. 영어 트랙 학생도 한국어 반에서 공부합니다.
The person who learns is a 학생, the person who teaches is a 교수님. English-track students also study in a Korean class.

i: 한국어 시험(TOPIK 등)을 볼 때 문제지와 안내에서 만나는 낱말입니다.
These are words you meet on the test paper and instructions when you take a Korean test such as TOPIK.
w: I'm taking the TOPIK test next month.
You apply for the TOPIK test online.
모르는 문제는 넘어가고 나중에 다시 보세요.
moreuneun munjeneun neomeogago najunge dasi boseyo
Skip the questions you don't know and look again later.
Copy your answers onto the answer sheet.
Listen and choose the right picture.
The listening questions are played only once.
듣기 연습으로 한국 드라마를 자막 없이 봐요.
deutki yeonseubeuro han-guk deuramareul jamak eopsi bwayo
For listening practice, I watch Korean dramas without subtitles.
I solve the reading questions first.
Ads and notices also come up in the reading test.
토픽 점수가 높으면 장학금을 받을 수 있어요.
topik jeomsuga nopeumyeon janghakkeumeul badeul su isseoyo
If your TOPIK score is high, you can get a scholarship.
Be sure to bring your admission ticket and ID.
If I pass, I'll apply for a scholarship.
Check the result on the website.
tp: 시험은 "보다"를 씁니다. 시험을 보다. 문제는 "풀다"를 씁니다.
With 시험 (test) use "보다": 시험을 보다 (to take a test). With 문제 (question) use "풀다" (to solve).
문제지에 자주 나오는 말입니다. "다음을 듣고 맞는 것을 고르십시오", "빈칸에 들어갈 말을 고르십시오".
Common test instructions: "다음을 듣고 맞는 것을 고르십시오" (Listen and choose the correct answer), "빈칸에 들어갈 말을 고르십시오" (Choose the word for the blank).
"-기"를 붙이면 동사가 낱말이 됩니다. 듣다 → 듣기, 읽다 → 읽기, 쓰다 → 쓰기.
Adding "-기" turns a verb into a noun: 듣다 → 듣기 (listening), 읽다 → 읽기 (reading), 쓰다 → 쓰기 (writing).
dl: Did your TOPIK test go well?
Listening was easy, but reading was hard.
When do the results come out?
sm: 시험은 "보다", 문제는 "풀다", 답은 "고르다"를 씁니다.
Use "보다" for a test, "풀다" for questions, and "고르다" for choosing answers.

i: 한국어 수업을 시작하기 전에 레벨 시험을 보고 반을 정합니다. 그때 쓰는 낱말입니다.
Before Korean classes start, you may take a level test to decide your class. These are the words you need then.
w: 레벨 테스트 결과에 따라 반이 정해져요.
rebel teseuteu gyeolgwa-e ttara bani jeonghaejeoyo
Your class is decided by the level test result.
The beginner class starts with Hangeul.
한국어를 처음 배우면 초급 반에 들어가요.
han-gugeoreul cheo-eum bae-umyeon chogeup bane deureogayo
If you're learning Korean for the first time, you go into the beginner class.
The intermediate class is a bit hard.
다음 학기에 중급 반에 가고 싶어요.
da-eum hakkie junggeup bane gago sipeoyo
I want to go to the intermediate class next semester.
In the intermediate class we also read Korean news.
You go up one level at a time.
일 단계를 마치면 이 단계로 올라가요.
il dan-gereul machimyeon i dan-gero ollagayo
When you finish level 1, you move up to level 2.
The class placement results are out.
I was placed in beginner class 2.
반 배정이 맞지 않으면 교수님께 말씀드리세요.
ban baejeongi matji aneumyeon gyosunimkke malsseumdeuriseyo
If your placement doesn't fit you, tell the professor.
I can read all of Hangeul.
한국에 오기 전에 한글을 미리 배웠어요.
han-guge ogi jeone han-geureul miri baewosseoyo
I learned Hangeul before coming to Korea.
It was too easy, so I changed classes.
If you want to change classes, apply in the first week.
tp: 학교마다 한국어 반 운영 방법이 다릅니다. 레벨 테스트와 반 배정은 학교 공지나 국제교류원에서 확인합니다.
Each school runs Korean classes differently. Check the level test and placement in school notices or at the International Office (국제교류원).
단계는 "일 단계, 이 단계"처럼 한자어 숫자로 셉니다.
Levels are counted with Sino-Korean numbers: 일 단계 (level 1), 이 단계 (level 2).
dl: 레벨 테스트 결과가 나왔어요. 딜노자 씨는 초급 이 반이에요.
The level test results are out. Dilnoza, you're in beginner class 2.
rebel teseuteu gyeolgwaga nawasseoyo dilloja ssineun chogeup i banieyo
저는 한글은 다 알아요. 너무 쉽지 않을까요?
I already know all of Hangeul. Won't it be too easy?
jeoneun han-geureun da arayo neomu swipji aneulkkayo?
첫 주에 들어 보고 쉬우면 말해 주세요.
Try it for the first week, and tell me if it's easy.
cheot ju-e deureo bogo swiumyeon malhae juseyo
네, 그럼 반을 옮길 수 있어요?
OK. Then can I change classes?
ne, geureom baneul omkkil su isseoyo?
네, 첫 주에는 옮길 수 있어요.
Yes, you can change in the first week.
ne, cheot ju-eneun omkkil su isseoyo
sm: 레벨 테스트를 보고 반이 배정됩니다. 맞지 않으면 빨리 말합니다.
You take a level test and are placed in a class. If it doesn't fit, say so early.

i: 학기마다 들을 과목을 고르고 신청할 때 쓰는 말입니다.
These are words for choosing and registering for courses each semester.
w: 수강 신청은 정해진 시간에 온라인으로 시작해요.
sugang sincheongeun jeonghaejin sigane olla-ineuro sijakaeyo
Course registration starts online at a set time.
I'm taking five courses this semester.
English-track courses are taught in English.
한 학기에 들을 수 있는 학점이 정해져 있어요.
han hakkie deureul su inneun hakjeomi jeonghaejeo isseoyo
The number of credits you can take in one semester is fixed.
졸업에 필요한 학점은 학과 사무실에서 확인하세요.
joreobe piryohan hakjeomeun hakkwa samusireseo hwaginhaseyo
Check the credits you need to graduate at the department office.
Major classes increase from second year.
I'm taking one more general education course.
교양 수업에는 다른 학과 학생이 많아요.
gyoyang su-eobeneun dareun hakkwa haksaengi manayo
There are many students from other departments in general education classes.
영어 트랙 학생은 한국어 수업도 같이 들어요.
yeongeo teuraek haksaengeun han-gugeo su-eopto gachi deureoyo
English-track students also take Korean classes.
시간표에 건물 이름과 강의실 번호가 나와요.
siganpyo-e geonmul ireumgwa gangisil beonhoga nawayo
The timetable shows the building name and classroom number.
마감 전에 신청 결과를 꼭 확인하세요.
magam jeone sincheong gyeolgwareul kkok hwaginhaseyo
Be sure to check your registration before the deadline.
tp: 인기 있는 수업은 몇 분 만에 마감됩니다. 시간표를 미리 짜 두고 정각에 신청합니다.
Popular classes fill up in minutes. Plan your timetable in advance and register right on time.
수업은 "듣다"를 씁니다. 수업을 듣다, 과목을 듣다. 졸업 학점과 필수 과목은 학과마다 다르니 꼭 확인합니다.
Use "듣다" for taking a class: 수업을 듣다, 과목을 듣다. Graduation credits and required courses differ by department, so always check.
dl: Did you register for your courses?
네, 경영학 전공 네 과목하고 한국어 한 과목을 신청했어요.
Yes, I signed up for four business administration courses and one Korean course.
ne, gyeongyeonghak jeon-gong ne gwamokago han-gugeo han gwamogeul sincheonghaesseoyo
십오 학점이에요. 전공은 다 영어로 수업해요.
Fifteen credits. All my major classes are taught in English.
sibo hakjeomieyo jeon-gongeun da yeongeoro su-eopaeyo

It helped a lot. Thank you for your time.
tp: 면담 시간(오피스 아워)은 교수님이 학생을 만나려고 연구실에 계시는 시간입니다. 강의계획서나 연구실 문에 써 있을 때가 많습니다.
Office hours are times when the professor is in the office to meet students. They are often in the syllabus or on the office door.
면담 시간이 맞지 않으면 이메일로 다른 시간을 부탁드립니다. 질문은 미리 정리해서 갑니다.
If office hours don't suit you, email to ask for another time. Prepare your questions before you go.
dl: Professor Hwang, may I come in for a moment?
중간고사 점수에 대해 여쭤보러 왔습니다. 서술형 문제가 이해가 안 돼요.
I came to ask about my midterm score. I don't understand the essay question.
junggan-gosa jeomsu-e daehae yeojjwoboreo watseumnida seosulhyeong munjega ihaega an dwaeyo
여기 보세요. 예를 더 써야 점수가 높아요.
Look here. You need more examples to get a higher score.
yeogi boseyo yereul deo sseoya jeomsuga nopayo
아, 알겠습니다. 시간 내 주셔서 감사합니다.
Oh, I see. Thank you for your time.
a, algetseumnida sigan nae jusyeoseo gamsahamnida
sm: 면담 시간에는 찾아온 이유를 말하고, 모르는 곳을 묻고, 감사 인사로 끝냅니다.
During office hours, say why you came, ask about what you don't understand, and end by thanking the professor.
qz: "May I come in for a moment?"를 한국어로?

i: 같은 취미를 가진 학생들의 모임인 동아리와 관련된 말입니다.
These words are about clubs, groups of students with the same hobbies.
w: I made a lot of Korean friends in my club.
I filled in the membership form.
The fee is 10,000 won a month.
We buy snacks with the fees.
I can't go to the meeting today.
I introduced myself at the first meeting.
Ask the president if you have questions.
I'm going on a club retreat.
We played games on the retreat.
Retreats are usually at the start of the semester.
tp: 학기 초에 동아리마다 신입 회원을 모집합니다. 학생회관 앞에서 홍보를 많이 합니다.
At the start of each semester, clubs recruit new members, often promoting in front of the student union building.
동아리는 한국 친구를 사귀고 한국어를 늘리는 좋은 방법입니다.
Clubs are a great way to make Korean friends and improve your Korean.
dl: Would you like to join our club?
Yes. Can international students join too?
그럼요. 모임은 매주 수요일이고, 회비는 한 달에 만 원이에요.
Of course. We meet every Wednesday, and the fee is 10,000 won a month.
geureomyo mo-imeun maeju suyo-irigo, hoebineun han dare man wonieyo
Great. I'll fill in the membership form.
sm: 동아리에 가입하면 모임과 엠티에서 한국 친구를 사귈 수 있습니다.
Join a club to make Korean friends at meetings and retreats.

i: 대학교의 여러 행사와 관련된 말입니다. 전주대학교에서는 봄에 대동제라는 축제를 엽니다.
These words are about university events. Jeonju University holds a spring festival called 대동제.
w: The school festival is next week.
The Jeonju University festival is called 대동제.
I went to the start-of-semester party.
The Hotel Management start-of-semester party is on Friday.
I met seniors at the start-of-semester party.
Our department has a sports day.
I played soccer at sports day.
체육 대회에는 모두 같은 옷을 입어요.
cheyuk daehoe-eneun modu gateun oseul ibeoyo
Everyone wears the same clothes on sports day.
I danced at the international student event.
I introduced Nepal at the international student event.
유학생 행사에는 여러 나라 음식이 나와요.
yuhaksaeng haengsa-eneun yeoreo nara eumsigi nawayo
There's food from many countries at international student events.
I took part in the festival.
If you're taking part, write your name.
We opened an Uzbek food booth.
We sold plov at the booth.
There were a lot of people in front of the booth.
tp: 축제 기간에는 학과나 동아리가 부스를 열고 음식을 팝니다. 2023년 대동제는 대운동장과 학생회관 일대에서 열렸습니다.
During the festival, departments and clubs open booths and sell food. In 2023, 대동제 was held around the main sports field and the student union building.
개강 파티나 엠티에서 술을 권해도 못 마시면 "저는 술을 못 마셔요"라고 말해도 괜찮습니다.
If someone offers you alcohol at a party or retreat and you don't drink, it's fine to say "저는 술을 못 마셔요" (I can't drink).
dl: Is there an international student booth at this festival?
Yes, Uzbek students are selling plov.
It's rice with meat and carrots. It's delicious!
I'll definitely come and eat some!
sm: 축제와 행사에 참가하면 학교 생활이 더 즐거워집니다.
Taking part in festivals and events makes campus life more fun.

i: 학교에서 한국 친구와 친해질 때 쓰는 표현입니다.
These are expressions for becoming friends with Korean students.
f: Do you want to eat together?
Do you want to eat together after class?
Do you want to eat together at the student cafeteria?
Do you want to have lunch together tomorrow?
Could you give me your contact?
과제 때문에 연락처 좀 알려 줄래요?
gwaje ttaemune yeollakcheo jom allyeo jullaeyo?
Could you give me your contact for the assignment?
카톡 아이디나 연락처 좀 알려 줄래요?
katok a-idina yeollakcheo jom allyeo jullaeyo?
Could you give me your KakaoTalk ID or number?
you can speak casually with me
우리 동갑이니까 말 편하게 해도 돼요.
uri donggabinikka mal pyeonhage haedo dwaeyo
We're the same age, so you can speak casually.
이제 친하니까 말 편하게 해도 돼요.
ije chinhanikka mal pyeonhage haedo dwaeyo
We're close now, so you can speak casually.
Come visit Greece during the vacation.
Food in Singapore is delicious. Come visit.
Come visit Nepal. I'll show you around.
한국어 좀 가르쳐 주세요. 저는 영어를 가르쳐 줄게요.
han-gugeo jom gareucheo juseyo jeoneun yeongeoreul gareucheo julgeyo
Please teach me some Korean. I'll teach you English.
Pronunciation is hard. Please teach me.
tp: "-(으)ㄹ래요?"는 친한 사이에서 부드럽게 제안할 때 씁니다.
"-(으)ㄹ래요?" is a soft way to suggest something to friends.
한국에서는 나이를 자주 묻습니다. 같은 나이(동갑)면 반말로 바꾸자고 하기도 합니다.
In Korea people often ask your age. If you're the same age (동갑), they may suggest switching to casual speech.
dl: 아이샤 씨, 수업 끝나고 같이 밥 먹을래요?
Aisha, do you want to eat together after class?
a-isya ssi, su-eop kkeunnago gachi bap meogeullaeyo?
좋아요! 우리 동갑이니까 말 편하게 해도 돼요.
Sure! We're the same age, so you can speak casually.
joayo uri donggabinikka mal pyeonhage haedo dwaeyo
OK, Aisha. Let's go to the student cafeteria.
좋아. 가는 길에 연락처도 알려 줘.
Great. Give me your number on the way too.
joa ganeun gire yeollakcheodo allyeo jwo
sm: 같이 밥을 먹자고 하고, 연락처를 묻고, 서로 말을 가르쳐 주면 쉽게 친해집니다.
Suggest eating together, ask for contacts and teach each other your languages to become friends easily.
qz: "Do you want to eat together?"를 한국어로?
You can speak casually with me.

i: 한국 학생과 유학생이 짝이 되어 서로 돕는 버디 활동과 언어 교환에 쓰는 말입니다. 프로그램이 있는지는 국제교류원에서 확인합니다.
These are words for buddy activities and language exchange, where a Korean student and an international student pair up to help each other. Ask the International Office whether a program is running.
w: My buddy showed me around campus.
버디 덕분에 외국인 등록을 쉽게 했어요.
beodi deokpune oegugin deungnogeul swipke haesseoyo
Thanks to my buddy, alien registration was easy.
I want to do a language exchange.
We practise Korean and English through language exchange.
언어 교환은 일주일에 한 번 카페에서 해요.
eoneo gyohwaneun ilju-ire han beon kape-eseo haeyo
We do our language exchange once a week at a café.
I did homework with my partner.
If your partner is busy, change to another day.
I signed up for the buddy program.
신청 기간이 짧으니까 공지를 잘 보세요.
sincheong gigani jjalbeunikka gongjireul jal boseyo
The sign-up period is short, so watch the notices.
이번 달 활동은 전주 한옥마을 구경이에요.
ibeon dal hwaldongeun jeonju hanongma-eul gugyeongieyo
This month's activity is visiting Jeonju Hanok Village.
We take photos of our activities and put them in the report.
I want to learn about Korean culture.
I introduced Bangladeshi culture to my buddy.
Our cultures are different, so it was a bit awkward at first.
tp: 언어 교환은 시간을 반으로 나누면 좋습니다. 삼십 분은 한국어, 삼십 분은 영어로 이야기합니다.
A good language exchange splits the time in half: thirty minutes in Korean, thirty minutes in English.
버디 프로그램이나 언어 교환 모임은 학교와 학기마다 다릅니다. 국제교류원 공지와 학교 누리집을 확인합니다.
Buddy programs and language exchange groups differ by school and semester. Check International Office notices and the school website.
dl: Nice to meet you! I'm from Bangladesh.
우리 언어 교환도 할래요? 저는 영어를 배우고 싶어요.
Shall we do a language exchange too? I want to learn English.
uri eoneo gyohwando hallaeyo? jeoneun yeongeoreul bae-ugo sipeoyo
좋아요. 저는 한국어를 배우고 싶어요. 일주일에 한 번 어때요?
Great. I want to learn Korean. How about once a week?
joayo jeoneun han-gugeoreul bae-ugo sipeoyo ilju-ire han beon eottaeyo?
Good. Let's meet at the Star Center on Thursday afternoon.
sm: 버디와 언어 교환으로 한국 친구를 사귀고 서로의 말과 문화를 배웁니다.
Through buddies and language exchange, you make Korean friends and learn each other's language and culture.

i: 학기마다 내는 학비와 관련된 말입니다.
These are words about the tuition you pay each semester.
w: You print the bill from the school portal.
Send the money to the account on the bill.
When is the tuition payment period?
납부 기간을 넘기면 등록이 안 돼요.
nappu giganeul neomgimyeon deungnogi an dwaeyo
If you miss the payment period, you're not registered.
Can I pay tuition in installments?
몇 번에 나눠서 낼 수 있어요?
myeot beone nanwoseo nael su isseoyo?
How many installments can I pay in?
You must apply in advance to pay in installments.
Please tell me the account number.
I opened an account at a Korean bank.
부모님이 파키스탄에서 제 계좌로 돈을 보내 주셨어요.
bumonimi pakiseutaneseo je gejwaro doneul bonae jusyeosseoyo
My parents sent money from Pakistan to my account.
Can I get a tuition refund?
If you take a leave of absence, you may get part of it back.
A refund takes some time after you apply.
tp: 등록금을 내야 그 학기 학생이 됩니다. 기간을 놓치면 큰 문제가 생길 수 있습니다.
You're only enrolled for the semester once you pay tuition. Missing the period can cause serious problems.
해외에서 돈을 보내면 수수료와 시간이 듭니다. 마감보다 일주일쯤 먼저 보냅니다.
Sending money from abroad takes fees and time. Send it about a week before the deadline.
dl: 등록금 고지서가 나왔는데 납부 기간이 언제까지예요?
The tuition bill is out. Until when is the payment period?
deungnokkeum gojiseoga nawanneunde nappu gigani eonjekkajiyeyo?
고지서에 써 있어요. 이번 달 이십 일까지예요.
It's on the bill. Until the 20th of this month.
gojiseo-e sseo isseoyo ibeon dal isip ilkkajiyeyo
sm: 등록금은 고지서를 보고 납부 기간 안에 냅니다. 어려우면 분할 납부를 신청합니다.
Check the bill and pay tuition within the payment period. If it's hard, apply to pay in installments.
qz: 돈을 여러 번에 나눠 내는 것은?

i: 장학금을 알아보고 신청할 때 쓰는 말입니다. 전주대학교 영어 트랙에도 장학금이 있습니다.
These are words for finding out about and applying for scholarships. Jeonju University's English track also has scholarships.
w: 영어 트랙 학생을 위한 장학금이 있어요.
yeongeo teuraek haksaengeul wihan janghakkeumi isseoyo
There are scholarships for English-track students.
Thanks to the scholarship, my tuition went down.
I was selected as a scholarship student.
Scholarship students must keep up their grades.
What are the requirements to apply?
조건에 맞으면 누구나 신청할 수 있어요.
jogeone majeumyeon nuguna sincheonghal su isseoyo
Anyone who meets the requirements can apply.
If you're selected, they'll let you know by text.
토픽 급수가 높으면 장학금을 받을 수 있어요.
topik geupsuga nopeumyeon janghakkeumeul badeul su isseoyo
If your TOPIK level is high, you can get a scholarship.
I'm taking the TOPIK test next month.
I wrote about my dream in my personal statement.
A senior corrected my personal statement.
tp: 전주대학교 영어 트랙 장학금 안내에는 토픽 사 급 이상을 따면 받는 토픽 장학금(백만 원)이 있습니다. 금액과 조건은 바뀔 수 있으니 공지를 꼭 확인합니다.

Jeonju University's English-track scholarship guide lists a TOPIK scholarship (1,000,000 won) for students who get TOPIK level 4 or higher. Amounts and conditions can change, so always check the notice.
"급을 따다"는 시험에 합격해서 등급을 받는 것입니다. 토픽 삼 급을 땄어요.
"급을 따다" means to pass a test and get a level: 토픽 삼 급을 땄어요 (I got TOPIK level 3).
dl: 선배, 유학생 장학금 신청 조건이 뭐예요?
What are the requirements for the international student scholarship?
seonbae, yuhaksaeng janghakkeum sincheong jogeoni mwoyeyo?
장학금마다 달라요. 토픽 장학금은 사 급 이상이에요.
It depends on the scholarship. The TOPIK scholarship is for level 4 or higher.
janghakkeummada dallayo topik janghakkeumeun sa geup isangieyo
저는 지난달에 토픽 사 급을 땄어요!
I got TOPIK level 4 last month!
jeoneun jinandare topik sa geubeul ttasseoyo
축하해요! 신청 기간이 짧으니까 빨리 국제교류원에 물어봐요.
Congratulations! The application period is short, so ask the International Office soon.
chukahaeyo sincheong gigani jjalbeunikka ppalli gukjegyoryuwone mureobwayo
sm: 장학금은 조건을 확인하고, 필요한 서류를 준비해 기간 안에 신청합니다.
For scholarships, check the requirements, prepare the documents and apply within the period.

i: 유학생이 아르바이트를 하기 전에 꼭 알아야 하는 기본 말입니다. 자세한 내용은 '아르바이트' 영역에서 배웁니다.
These are the basic words international students must know before working part-time. You learn more in the "아르바이트" (part-time jobs) area.
w: I work part-time at a convenience store.
Because of my part-time job, I don't have enough time to study.
I got a part-time work permit.
You must not work without a permit.
시간제 취업 허가는 국제교류원 확인을 받고 신청해요.
siganje chwieop heoganeun gukjegyoryuwon hwagineul batko sincheonghaeyo
You apply for the part-time work permit after getting confirmation from the International Office.
The 2026 minimum hourly wage is 10,320 won.
시급은 최저 시급보다 적으면 안 돼요.
sigeubeun choejeo sigeuppoda jeogeumyeon an dwaeyo
The hourly wage must not be less than the minimum wage.
유학생은 일할 수 있는 시간이 정해져 있어요.
yuhaksaengeun ilhal su inneun sigani jeonghaejeo isseoyo
International students have a fixed limit on working hours.
I cut my working hours during exam period.
Be sure to get a copy of your employment contract.
근로 계약서가 있어야 허가를 신청할 수 있어요.
geullo geyakseoga isseoya heogareul sincheonghal su isseoyo
You need an employment contract to apply for the permit.
You can also get a weekly holiday allowance.
일주일에 십오 시간 이상 일하면 주휴 수당이 있어요.
ilju-ire sibo sigan isang ilhamyeon juhyu sudangi isseoyo
If you work 15 hours or more a week, you get a weekly holiday allowance.
I asked the owner about the weekly holiday allowance.
tp: 유학생은 시간제 취업 허가를 먼저 받아야 아르바이트를 할 수 있습니다. 허가 없이 일하면 벌금을 내거나 비자에 문제가 생길 수 있습니다.
International students must get a part-time work permit before working. Working without one can lead to fines or visa problems.
일할 수 있는 시간은 학위 과정, 학년, 한국어 실력(토픽 급수)에 따라 다릅니다. 하이코리아와 국제교류원에서 확인합니다.
How many hours you may work depends on your degree, year and Korean level (TOPIK). Check on HiKorea and with the International Office.
dl: Are you an international student? Do you have a part-time work permit?
계약서를 쓰고 신청하려고 해요. 시급이 얼마예요?
I'm going to apply after signing the contract. What's the hourly wage?
geyakseoreul sseugo sincheongharyeogo haeyo sigeubi eolmayeyo?
최저 시급이에요. 근로 계약서를 먼저 써요.
Minimum wage. Let's write the employment contract first.
choejeo sigeubieyo geullo geyakseoreul meonjeo sseoyo
OK. I'll start working once the permit is issued.
sm: 유학생 아르바이트는 허가, 근로 계약서, 시급, 근무 시간을 꼭 확인합니다.
For part-time jobs, international students must check the permit, the contract, the hourly wage and working hours.

i: 졸업을 준비할 때 쓰는 말입니다.
These are words for preparing to graduate.
w: After graduating, I'll go back to the US.
I decided on my thesis topic.
졸업 논문은 지도 교수님이 봐 주세요.
joreop nonmuneun jido gyosunimi bwa juseyo
My academic advisor reviews my thesis.
My parents are coming to the graduation ceremony.
I took lots of photos on graduation day.
The graduation ceremony is usually in February.
I want to get a master's degree.
A degree helps with getting a job.
학점이 모자라서 졸업 요건을 못 채웠어요.
hakjeomi mojaraseo joreop yogeoneul mot chaewosseoyo
I didn't have enough credits, so I didn't meet the graduation requirements.
I wore a graduation cap and took photos.
We threw our caps in the air.
We rent the gown and cap.
tp: 졸업 요건(학점, 필수 과목, 한국어 등)은 학과와 입학 연도마다 다를 수 있습니다. 학과 사무실에서 일찍 확인합니다.
Graduation requirements (credits, required courses, Korean level, etc.) may differ by department and entry year. Check early at the department office.
학위는 학사(대학교), 석사, 박사 순서입니다.
Degrees go in this order: bachelor's (학사), master's (석사), doctorate (박사).
dl: John, did you finish your thesis?
거의 다 썼어. 황인수 교수님이 봐 주셨어.
Almost. Professor Hwang looked at it for me.
geo-i da sseosseo hwanginsu gyosunimi bwa jusyeosseo
Are your parents coming to the graduation ceremony?
Yes, they're coming from the US.
sm: 졸업 요건을 미리 확인하고 논문과 학점을 준비합니다.
Check the graduation requirements early and prepare your thesis and credits.
